single.answer: The GPT-2 small model has 12 layers, 12 attention heads per layer, and uses learned position embeddings. In contrast, the LLaMA 3 8B model has 32 layers, with 32 query heads and 8 key-value heads per layer (grouped-query attention), and uses rotary position embeddings. Both models encode positions differently: GPT-2 small uses learned position embeddings, while LLaMA 3 8B uses rotary position embeddings. The LLaMA 3 8B model also has a larger d_model (4096) and more parameters (8.0B) compared to GPT-2 small (124M).
